definitions.gloss: fresh green leaves; new foliage; verdure
definitions.explanation: The lush green leaves of trees and plants, especially the fresh new leaves that appear in late spring and early summer. A seasonal word associated with the beauty of nature in May and June.

examples.japanese: {青葉|あおば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
⟦{木々|きぎ}→木々：04811_kigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{青葉|あおば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れている→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
examples.english: The green leaves on the trees are swaying in the wind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{青葉|あおば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われて→覆う：02020_oou⟧、⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧だ。
examples.english: In May, the mountains are covered with fresh green leaves, vivid to the eye.

notes:
Refers specifically to the fresh, vibrant green foliage of late spring and early summer. Composed of ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (green/blue) + {葉|ば} (leaf/leaves). A poetic and seasonal word strongly associated with May and June.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青葉|あおば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧: the season of fresh green leaves
- {青葉|あおば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧: green leaves grow thick
- {青葉|あおば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}: around the time of fresh green foliage
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{青葉|あおば}: green leaves pleasing to the eye (from a famous haiku)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In haiku, {青葉|あおば} is a ⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧ (seasonal word) for early summer. The famous phrase ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{青葉|あおば} {山|やま}ほととぎす {初鰹|はつがつお} by {山口素堂|やまぐちそどう} celebrates three seasonal pleasures: green leaves for the eyes, the cuckoo for the ears, and the first bonito for the palate.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{新緑|しんりょく}→新緑：12724_shinryoku⟧: fresh greenery — similar meaning but more general; also a seasonal word for early summer
- ⟦{若葉|わかば}→若葉：19659_wakaba⟧: young leaves — emphasizes the newness of the leaves rather than their color
- ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧: autumn foliage — the seasonal counterpart to {青葉|あおば}
